text: Elara tightened her grip on the cold steel railing of the mag-lev transport as it hummed its way across the Pacific towards the Neo-Western colonies. It was 2147, and she was leaving behind the suffocating digital surveillance of her traditional life in a small, offline enclave in the Old World for the promise of anonymity and adventure in the Free Zones. She clutched her small, battered data-drive that contained all her worldly possessions, her heart racing with both fear and excitement. Tell me what a book is primarily made of.
